assuranceCeiling.rationale: The product-side workforce convergence is already technically verified, but the Template Factory E13 browser harness still targets the removed legacy platform password UI. This isolated transaction changes only quality infrastructure so the proof follows the canonical Workforce Auth entrypoint without weakening proof semantics or reopening product authority.

acceptanceCriteria: The E13 Product Owner/engine proof navigates directly to /api/auth/workforce-login with next=/admin/platform rather than relying on the legacy /platform password form.
The proof scopes credential locators to the canonical data-workforce-auth surface and submits with the canonical workforce password-step control.
The proof still requires successful navigation to /admin/platform; MFA enrollment/challenge, missing workforce access, or any unexpected redirect fails closed instead of being bypassed.
A deterministic DOMAIN-QUALITY architecture regression locks the canonical route, workforce root, submit selector, and removal of the legacy platform-login selector into the proof-harness contract.
No Shoperation product route, Auth Core primitive, role/tenant authority, middleware, or parked AAL2 enforcement changes in this release.
The release remains an isolated quality-infrastructure transaction within the canonical Release Risk Budget.

Changes to scripts/template-factory-product-owner-handoff.mjs trigger Template Factory Quality Gate v2 on both push and pull_request so the proof producer cannot change without exact-head browser proof.
invariants: Supabase Auth and the existing Workforce Auth Core remain the only workforce authentication authority.
The proof harness is a consumer of the canonical workforce entrypoint; it must not recreate credential/session/MFA policy.
Product runtime files are read-only in this transaction.
PR #858 remains parked and AAL2 enforcement stays inactive.
A green proof cannot be obtained by restoring the legacy PlatformAuthForm button or skipping workforce navigation.
The proof producer is included in both Template Factory workflow path filters; manual workflow dispatch is not accepted as a substitute because E13 browser proof is pull-request scoped.

failureModes: The browser harness waits forever for the removed Belépés a Shoperationbe control on /platform.
The harness enters shopper authentication instead of the canonical workforce surface.
The harness silently treats an MFA enrollment/challenge as successful platform authentication.
The fix modifies product routes or Auth Core and recreates a mixed release-risk transaction.
A source-only assertion passes while the exact-head browser journey still cannot reach /admin/platform.
The handoff proof producer changes but path filters suppress Template Factory Quality Gate, allowing source tests to pass without the exact-head E13 journey.
edgeCases: An existing valid storageState may still short-circuit through /admin/platform exactly as before.
Without reusable storageState the proof must use the canonical workforce login route.
The workforce form begins in checking/loading state before exposing the password phase.
The exact-head preview may require a deliberate one-off Vercel preview while normal branch builds remain ignored.
Any required MFA step remains fail-closed until the parked enforcement/fixture strategy is intentionally changed.
Both push and pull_request path filters must include the handoff proof producer even though the E13 credential journey itself only executes on pull_request.

specialistReviews.resolution: Change only the handoff harness and its regression test; keep product/Auth Core read-only.

specialistReviews.finding: A proof fix must not bypass workforce MFA/access checks merely to restore a green E13 run.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use the real canonical workforce form and keep /admin/platform navigation mandatory; unexpected MFA/access states remain failures.

specialistReviews.finding: The proof producer must self-trigger its exact-head gate, but mixing that infrastructure with product delegates exceeds the canonical budget.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep both proof producer and its workflow trigger in this isolated infrastructure release; expected release risk is quality-infrastructure medium + release-infrastructure medium, with no product subsystem.

requirements.requirement: The E13 browser proof consumes the canonical workforce entrypoint, preserves fail-closed platform authentication semantics, and automatically triggers exact-head Template Factory proof whenever its producer changes.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The E13 proof must not depend on the removed legacy platform login button or PlatformAuthForm.
The proof must not bypass canonical workforce access/MFA state to obtain a green result.
A handoff proof-producer change must not bypass Template Factory Quality Gate through an incomplete path filter.

requirements.requirement: The proof-harness compatibility fix ships as an isolated quality-infrastructure release within the canonical Release Risk Budget.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: The harness release must not include substantive product/Auth Core subsystems or exceed the canonical release-risk budget.

notes: The Stage 1 product-only delegator implementation was already technically VERIFIED, but exact-head Template Factory proof exposed a stale E13 login harness. Mixing the harness fix into PR #912 produced Release Risk Budget BLOCK at 7/5 points across quality-infrastructure + admin-operations + customer-account + storefront-ui. This branch is the required isolated quality-infrastructure transaction. PR #912 remains draft until this fix lands on main; PR #858 remains parked and AAL2 enforcement remains inactive. During isolation, the workflow path filter was proven incomplete: scripts/template-factory-product-owner-handoff.mjs was executed by the gate but did not itself trigger that gate. The isolated release therefore includes the two path-filter entries as a release-infrastructure dependency; this remains below the canonical risk ceiling and is required for truthful exact-head proof.
